newsitem.title: USA: Gilead GS 4104 inhibits influenza in mice.
newsitem.headline: Gilead GS 4104 inhibits influenza in mice.

text.p: Gilead Sciences Inc said Tuesday it has discovered a compound that inhibits the replication of the influenza virus in mice.

In a preclinical model, GS 4104 showed antiviral activity against multiple strains of influenza, increased survival and decreased viral levels in lung tissue after it was fed to mice, the company said.
The company said it is completing additional preclinical studies needed to begin human clinical testing of GS 4104.
